body:
NFL DFS Projections Week 10: DraftKings Picks, Values and Sim Plays

DraftKings main slate · Sunday, November 15 · 10 games · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of November 13, 10:49 AM ET

Bijan Robinson carries the highest SPAGS model projection on the Week 10 DraftKings main slate: 25.3 DraftKings points at $8,200. He also holds 43% of the simulated winning-lineup credit across 10,000 simulations, more than any other player on the slate, with Chris Olave second at 21% for $7,000.

Behind Robinson, the model's next four projections are Kenneth Walker III (22.9, $9,200), Brock Purdy (22.1, $7,000), Josh Allen (22.1, $7,500) and Christian McCaffrey (20.6, $8,500). Brock Purdy returns the most per dollar of that group at 3.16 projected points per $1,000. CeeDee Lamb leads the wide receivers at 20.1 for $8,800, Brock Purdy leads the quarterbacks at 22.1 for $7,000, and Trey McBride leads the tight ends at 17.6 for $7,100.

The 10-game slate runs from a 55.5-point total in SF at DAL down to 38.5 in MIA at IND. Every projection below is a SPAGS model estimate from the November 13, 10:49 AM ET run of the Splash Play NFL model. Winning-lineup credit comes from 10,000 simulations of the contest, and tied winning entries share credit. A player's simulated floor is his 10th-percentile score and his ceiling is his 95th.

Quarterbacks: Week 10 DraftKings projections

Brock Purdy, SF at DAL ($7,000)

Brock Purdy carries the highest SPAGS model projection at the position, 22.1 DraftKings points at $7,000, the 3rd-highest on the entire main slate. That is 0.0 points clear of Josh Allen. The model includes 4.2 rushing attempts. The salary works out to 3.16 projected points per $1,000, 6th of 15 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Purdy averaged 22.3 points with a simulated floor of 9.0 and a ceiling of 39.9, and he holds 12% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. San Francisco is a 3.5-point favorite on the road against Dallas, with an implied team total of 29.5 in a game totaled at 55.5.

Josh Allen, BUF at NYJ ($7,500)

Josh Allen projects 2nd at the position with 22.1 DraftKings points at $7,500, 4th on the main slate overall. The model includes 6.7 rushing attempts. The salary works out to 2.94 projected points per $1,000, 10th of 15 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Allen averaged 22.0 points with a simulated floor of 8.3 and a ceiling of 40.1, and he holds 11% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Buffalo is an 8.5-point favorite on the road against the Jets, with an implied team total of 29.5 in a game totaled at 50.5.

Value: Tyler Shough, NO vs CAR ($5,600)

Tyler Shough projects for 19.8 DraftKings points at $5,600, which works out to 3.54 points per $1,000 of salary. That is the best rate of any player priced in the cheaper half of the 15 quarterbacks the model projects for 15 or more points. The model includes 3.9 rushing attempts. Across 10,000 simulations Shough averaged 20.0 points with a simulated floor of 8.3 and a ceiling of 36.4, and he holds 17% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. New Orleans is a 2.5-point favorite at home against Carolina, with an implied team total of 25.5 in a game totaled at 48.5.
